name: War Risk Index
product: Transparent open-news war risk signal for analysts, researchers, and globally exposed teams
slogan: A clearer signal when conflict coverage gets loud.
nonAffiliation: Independent public information tool. Not affiliated with GDELT, ACLED, UCDP, CFR, Google, any government, insurer, broker, or military organization.

pricing.reason: Free public information site. No checkout, paid gate, subscription, or payment collection is used.

trustDataLedger.claim: GDELT monitors global print, broadcast, and web news in over 100 languages and updates primary streams every 15 minutes.
trustDataLedger.displayDecision: Used as the live open-news signal backbone.

trustDataLedger.claim: GDELT DOC 2.0 provides JSON timeline and article-list modes for recent coverage analysis.
trustDataLedger.displayDecision: Used for the Worker risk endpoint and methodology.

trustDataLedger.claim: ACLED Conflict Index ranks conflict intensity using deadliness, danger to civilians, geographic diffusion, and armed-group fragmentation.
trustDataLedger.displayDecision: Used as benchmark methodology context, not copied as live data.

trustDataLedger.claim: UCDP exposes RESTful JSON APIs for conflict datasets, including GED, with current version notes and paging.
trustDataLedger.displayDecision: Used as official structured conflict-data context.

trustDataLedger.claim: Wikimedia Analytics API provides page-view endpoints for Wikimedia projects, including per-article daily page views.
trustDataLedger.displayDecision: Used only as a public-attention fallback when GDELT is unavailable or rate-limited.

trustDataLedger.claim: CFR Global Conflict Tracker documents conflict selection using violence, humanitarian impact, and escalation risk criteria.
trustDataLedger.displayDecision: Used to shape plain-language status labels and limitations.

completionLedger.evidence: SERP, GDELT, ACLED, UCDP, CFR, and direct competitor pages reviewed.
Pricing and checkout are intentionally disabled; no payment or paid gate is part of the requested website.
Cloudflare zone, DNS, HTTPS certificate, Worker routes, D1 binding, and production probes passed for warriskindex.blog.
Public site and docs repositories were created and pushed on GitHub.
